workarounds.note: the plate's woodcut is drawn by the plate style's header, on the sheet: postext-pdf draws a design image of a vertical page's flow turned a quarter turn and stretched to its box (VDTDesignImageBlock.upright is not read by headerFooter.ts renderImageBlock), while the canvas and the HTML stand it upright; as a header picture it is a pagination artifact in the tagged PDF, without its alt text

renderPageToCanvas paints with the direction the canvas inherits from the page (ctx.direction 'inherit'); the cjk kit's showBook sets dir="rtl" on each spread of a right-bound book, so horizontal Latin text (the title page's imprint) is reordered by the bidi algorithm and anchored from the right, and letter-spaced text (the title) shifts. The pen sets #pages canvas { direction: ltr }; the fix belongs in renderPageToCanvas (set ctx.direction = 'ltr') or in the kit's showBook style.
